theorems.name: Submission.deGiorgiHS_blowUp_divergence_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (E : Set (Rn N)) (μ : Measure (Rn N)) (ν : Rn N → Rn N) (x : Rn N) (ρ₁ C : ℝ), (∀ᵐ y ∂μ, ‖ν y‖ = 1) → (∀ ρ ∈ Ioo 0 ρ₁, μ (Metric.ball x ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C * ρ ^ n)) → (∀ r R : ℝ, 0 < r → 0 < R → r * R < ρ₁ → ∀ g : Rn N → Rn N, ContDiff ℝ 1 g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ Metric.ball 0 R → ∫ z in blowUpMap x r '' E, Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter02.euclideanDivergence g z = -((r ^ n)⁻¹ * ∫ y, inner ℝ (g (blowUpMap x r y)) (ν y) ∂μ)) → ∀ r R : ℝ, 0 < r → 0 < R → r * R < ρ₁ → ∀ g : Rn N → Rn N, ContDiff ℝ 1 g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ Metric.ball 0 R → (∀ y, ‖g y‖ ≤ 1) → ∫ z in blowUpMap x r '' E, Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter02.euclideanDivergence g z ≤ max C 0 * R ^ n
